title: Oil price shocks as IV for inflation on investment
research_question: Does inflation reduce corporate investment, using oil price shocks as an instrument for inflation to address the endogeneity of inflation with economic activity?
data_description: Panel data on 500 firm-quarter observations. Variables: y (log investment), x (inflation rate), z (oil price change — instrument), controls (firm size, leverage, Q). Challenge: oil prices may directly affect investment beyond inflation channel (exclusion restriction is debatable).
